content.text: First use the add tool to compute 3 + 4. After you receive that result, use the subtract tool to subtract 5 from it. Then state the final number in one short sentence.

body.instructions: You are a calculator. Use the provided tools instead of doing arithmetic yourself. Call exactly one tool at a time and wait for its result before deciding the next step.

tools.description: Subtract y from x (i.e.: x - y)
tools.name: subtract
